synthetic_generic_holdout_80.scope_note: Synthetic generic Northstar holdout. Useful regression test, not a production-accuracy claim.

architecture.url_model: PhreshPhish-trained hashed character n-grams + lexical logistic component
architecture.text: PhishLens DistilBERT retained as a secondary signal only
architecture.fusion: URL-first risk fusion with authenticated-tracker exception and hard-rule overrides

important_scope_note: The 99% result is on a deliberately difficult but synthetic 100-email stress suite used for regression. It is not universal production accuracy. The independent PhreshPhish URL test is the more external URL generalization check. Full Gmail raw-MIME production evaluation still requires a real labelled inbox corpus.
